snippet.title: Tactichord: Glam Strategy Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Award-winning studio Ichigoichie is making a new game!

Tactichord: Glam Strategy is a mashup of turn-based tactics and music games. Rock on turning foes into fans while making lyrical and audio choices during battle to create your own glam metal anthems. Experience a homage to 1990s ensemble dramedies, choosing when to embrace angst and empathy.

Wishlist now! https://store.steampowered.com/app/3389400/Tactichord_Glam_Strategy/

Features
* Use melee performances to convert non-believers into heavy metal fans
* Build up your resources to unleash each character's epic power move
* Create a glam music video of your gameplay, choosing the song's lyrics
* Experience a character-driven story set in 1990s suburban America with a band you can name
* Support or antagonize bandmates with dialog choices
* Customize musical playback with vanity audio effects, instruments, and costumes

Join our Discord to share your opinion on the game's development and stay up to date with dev logs, contests, and giveaways! https://151a.games/discord
